note: The round airlock hub that stands at every node of the curving tubes, where they branch and where one ends (INTERFACES 'Wave 4.1b'). tube-kit is generated by tools/assets/tube_kit.py in STUDS, scale 1.0. Origin = the hub's centre on the ground = the node. It has no front: a twelve-sided drum, the same after any turn of 30 degrees, so its rotation does not matter and a swept tube may run into it from any direction and end inside it. 4.6 across its grey base ring, 4.24 across the white drum, 2.6 tall; the drum's wall runs to 2.0, above a pipe's rings (1.88), so a pipe always enters through plain wall under the grey collar; a lit skylight closes the top.
